spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Whisper API platform-level key (not per-tenant) — single OpenAI API key in appsettings
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: MVP simplicity, tenant-level key management deferred to Faz 2
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Single API key in config, no per-tenant key table

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Transcribe → text inject into existing flow (Option A), not new voice node
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Zero flow changes, MVP scope. message_type metadata preserved for future branching

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Audio files transcribed then deleted (no persistent storage)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q decision: transcribe and delete, no S3/disk retention
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Temp file cleanup after transcription, no permanent audio storage

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Intent detection delegated to ChatAnalysis service via internal HTTP call
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Reuse existing Haiku-based intent pipeline, no duplication
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: VoiceAI calls ChatAnalysis /api/v1/analyze, cross-service HTTP is by design

plan.summary: PKT-11 Faz 1: VoiceAI MVP microservice — Whisper API STT, transcript → ChatAnalysis intent pipeline, temp audio delete. New .NET 8 service on port 7114 with Backend proxy routes.
plan.q_intent: PKT-11 VoiceAI: Yeni mikroservis, Whisper STT, ses kaydı transcribe + intent detection (ChatAnalysis'e besle), transcribe sonrası sil
plan.interview_notes: Q decisions: (1) Whisper API cloud, platform-level key, (2) Any audio source (not just WhatsApp), (3) Intent via ChatAnalysis pipeline, (4) STT+intent only (no TTS), (5) Option A: transcribe→text inject, no new flow node, (6) Transcribe and delete audio

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invekto.VoiceAI microservice runs on port 7114 with health endpoint returning healthy
POST /api/v1/voice/transcribe accepts audio (multipart/form-data), calls Whisper API, returns transcript text
After transcription, transcript is forwarded to ChatAnalysis /api/v1/analyze for intent detection and intent result is returned
Temporary audio file is deleted after successful transcription (no persistent audio storage)
Backend proxy routes forward /api/v1/voice/* to VoiceAI 7114
VoiceAI appears in /api/ops/health aggregation and /api/ops/endpoints discovery
Error codes INV-VA-001..006 defined in ErrorCodes.cs and used in all error paths
voice_transcriptions table created (transcription log with tenant_id, duration, language, word_count)
Solution builds with zero errors and zero warnings after adding Invekto.VoiceAI

files_changed.change: VA service code + INV-VA error entries

verification_questions.question: Does VoiceAI service validate JWT tokens on /api/v1/ endpoints and use X-Internal-Api-Key for service-to-service ChatAnalysis calls?
Is tenant_id extracted from JWT and used in voice_transcriptions INSERT and all DB queries?
Are temporary audio files reliably deleted in both success and error paths (finally block or equivalent)?
Does the Whisper API call have appropriate timeout and error handling with feature-specific error codes (INV-VA-xxx)?

forbidden_areas: src/Invekto.Automation/ — no flow node changes (Option A)
non_goals: Per-tenant Whisper API keys — platform-level only
Voice-specific flow node — Option A (text inject)
Audio file permanent storage — transcribe and delete
Dashboard voice UI — no frontend in Faz 1
intentional_exclusions: No Automation/FlowBuilder changes (voice handled as text after transcription)
No audio retention policy (immediate delete after transcribe)
No language detection (Whisper auto-detects, we pass through)

user_facing_errors: INV-VA-001: No audio file in request
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All error paths have typed catches with INV-VA error codes and logging. Temp file cleanup in finally block.
